text:
Jesper Bratt has been at the center of New Jersey's run, and he finished one of its wildest nights: the overtime winner against St. Louis on Nov. 5, after the Devils blew a three-goal lead in the third. The Devils have won nine of their last ten games, and Bratt has a five-game point streak (1 goal, 6 assists).

He's a passer first. Fifteen of his 18 points are assists, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him 94th percentile among forwards in primary shot assists last season. The Devils take 65.1% of the 5v5 expected goals with him on the ice, 10 points better than without him.

The goals are the one thing missing: 3 on 5.1 expected, shooting 7.1%. Evolving-Hockey had him better than his finishing last season too. He keeps getting the looks, so we'd expect that number to climb.
headline: Bratt sets them up, the goals will come
